beschreibung:
Historic Hilltop Castle in the East Tyrolean Drautal

Rising on an isolated hill spur near Nikolsdorf stands the imposing Schloss Lengberg. Originally founded in the 12th century by the Counts of Lechsgemünde, the medieval fortress was expanded in the late Middle Ages into a stately palace featuring multi-storey arcades.

Sensational Discoveries in Textile Archaeology

The castle grounds caused an international sensation through archaeological finds in the vault of the chapel: researchers uncovered the world's oldest preserved brassieres dating from the 15th century. Today, the complex serves as a renowned educational and cultural centre for Osttirol.
